'''Ku-Rio''' is a KU-Roro that can be found in [[Energy Hub]], [[Tethys' Deep]], near charging stations.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|KU-Rio}}

==Idle Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''KU-Rio:''' Rest! I need rest!
:'''KU-Rio:''' Wake up! It's my turn to charge now—
:'''KU:''' Ku... Just five more minutes... I worked overtime yesterday.
:'''KU-Rio:''' Adrian updated my hardware yesterday, and now I only have access to this charging station.
:'''KU:''' Alright, we can share. Just leave me some space.
:'''KU-Rio:''' W-why are you blushing!? Somebody come fix this guy! ADRIAN—
{{Dialogue End}}
